name: School
definition: A California public school directory record with identity, location, grade span and program flags.

name: School enrollment and meal counts
definition: Per school and academic year enrollment with free/reduced-price meal eligible counts.

name: School SAT score summary
definition: Per school or district SAT reading, math and writing averages with tested and benchmark counts.

name: Eligible free meal rate
definition: Share of enrolled students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.

name: Excellence rate
definition: Ratio of the benchmark-achieving count to the tested count in the SAT summary.

name: Grade span
definition: Lowest and highest grade served by a school, e.g. K-5, K-8, 9-12.

name: District type code
definition: California district type code, e.g. 52 Elementary School District, 54 Unified School District.

name: School type code
definition: California school type code, e.g. 62 Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), 65 K-12 Schools (Public).

name: Special school code
definition: Special-program school code such as TRAD (traditional) or SSS (State Special School).

name: Virtual school status
definition: School virtual-delivery status code (F, N, P). Workload evidence treats F as exclusively virtual.

name: Magnet program flag
definition: Flag showing whether a school offers a magnet program (1 = yes).

name: School administrator
definition: Name and e-mail of the person administering a school.

name: Magic card
definition: English printing of a Magic: The Gathering card with artist, cost, rarity, text and set code.

name: Card printing in a language
definition: Per-language printing of a card with localized name, rules text and flavor text.

name: Card format legality
definition: Legality of a card printing in one play format.

name: Card set
definition: Magic set identity with set code, set name, block and release date.

name: Localized set name
definition: Set code and language mapped to the localized set name.

name: Card ruling
definition: Official ruling text issued for a card on a date.

name: Card language
definition: Language of a card printing or set localization, e.g. French, German, Italian, Korean.

name: Play format
definition: Constructed or limited format name such as commander, vintage, legacy, gladiator.

name: Legality status
definition: Whether a card is Legal, Banned or Restricted in a format.

name: Card rarity
definition: Card rarity: common, uncommon, rare or mythic.

name: Card artist
definition: Illustrator credited on the card.

name: Card name
definition: Card name in English or, in tb005, the localized printed name.

name: Converted mana cost
definition: Casting cost converted to a single number (mana value).

name: EDHRec rank
definition: Popularity rank of a card on EDHRec; rank 1 is the most popular.

name: Card power
definition: Power value of a creature card; NULL or '*' means the card has no power.

name: Card attribute flag
definition: Boolean card attributes: content-warning/degraded-data flag, Story Spotlight flag and border color.

name: Card subtype
definition: Comma-separated creature subtypes such as Human,Cleric.

name: Card flavor text
definition: Localized flavor text printed on a card.

name: Energy customer
definition: Customer of the fuel/energy retailer with a segment and a payment currency.

name: Customer segment
definition: Customer segment: SME, LAM or KAM.

name: Customer payment currency
definition: Currency in which a customer pays: CZK or EUR.

name: Gas station
definition: Fuel retail station with chain number and country.

name: Fuel product
definition: Product sold at a station, e.g. diesel (Nafta), natural gas, car wash.

name: Fuel transaction
definition: Point-of-sale transaction with customer, station, product, quantity and amount.

name: Monthly consumption
definition: Consumption amount for a customer in a year-month.

name: Year-month key
definition: Six-character year-month key YYYYMM used by the consumption table.

name: Bank district
definition: Czech bank district with name, region, population and average salary.

name: District region
definition: Region grouping of a bank district, e.g. Prague, north Bohemia.

name: District average salary
definition: Average salary reported for a bank district.

name: Bank client
definition: Client with sex, birth date and home district.

name: Client sex
definition: Client sex code: M or F.

name: Bank account
definition: Account with opening date, statement frequency and district.

name: Statement frequency
definition: Statement issuance frequency: monthly, weekly or after transaction.

name: Account disposition
definition: Link between a client and an account with OWNER or DISPONENT role.

name: Bank loan
definition: Loan approved on an account with amount, duration and status.

name: Loan status
definition: Loan contract status code A-D.

name: Account transaction
definition: Debit/credit transaction on an account with amount, balance and operation type.

name: Transaction direction
definition: Whether a transaction is a credit (PRIJEM) or a debit/withdrawal (VYDAJ).

name: Transaction operation
definition: Operation category of a transaction, e.g. cash withdrawal (VYBER), deposit (VKLAD), transfer.

name: Transaction amount and balance
definition: Monetary amount of a transaction and the resulting account balance.

name: Formula 1 circuit
definition: Race circuit with reference name, location, country and coordinates.

name: Formula 1 constructor
definition: Team/constructor with reference name and nationality.

name: Formula 1 driver
definition: Driver with reference name, number, code, forename, surname, birth date and nationality.

name: Formula 1 race
definition: Grand Prix event with season year, round, circuit, name and date.

name: Race result
definition: Driver result in a race: grid, position, points, laps, time and fastest-lap facts.

name: Qualifying result
definition: Driver qualifying result per race with Q1/Q2/Q3 lap times.

name: Lap time
definition: Individual lap time recorded for a driver in a race.

name: Championship standing
definition: Driver or constructor standing after a race with points, position and wins.

name: Result status
definition: Classification status of a race result, e.g. Finished, Accident, +1 Lap.

name: Nationality
definition: Free-text nationality shared by drivers and constructors, e.g. British, Japanese.

name: Driver full name
definition: Full driver name formed by combining forename and surname.

name: Race points
definition: Championship points awarded to a driver or constructor in a race.

name: Fastest lap
definition: Fastest lap facts of a result: lap number, lap time and speed.

name: Student club member
definition: Student-club member with first name, last name, e-mail, role, t-shirt size and major.

name: Member full name
definition: Full member name formed by combining first name and last name.

name: Academic major
definition: Major program with department and college attribution.

name: Club event
definition: Event with name, date-time, type, location and status.

name: Event attendance
definition: Link between an event and an attending member.

name: Event budget line
definition: Budget line for an event category with spent and budgeted amounts.

name: Club expense
definition: Expense with description, date, amount and responsible member.

name: Club income
definition: Income with date, amount, source and member.

name: Budget category
definition: Expense/budget category such as Food, Advertisement, Speaker Gifts.

name: Event type
definition: Event type such as Meeting, Game, Election, Guest Speaker.

name: Event status
definition: Event status: Open, Closed or Planning.

name: Income source
definition: Income source such as Dues, Fundraising, Sponsorship.

name: Club monetary amount
definition: Monetary amount of a budget, expense or income record.

name: Superhero
definition: Comic superhero with name, full name, physical attributes and lookup-based descriptors.

name: Superpower
definition: Named superpower such as Agility, Stealth or Accelerated Healing.

name: Hero superpower link
definition: Link between a superhero and one of their superpowers.

name: Hero attribute score
definition: Numeric score of a superhero on one attribute.

name: Attribute type
definition: Attribute name: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power or Combat.

name: Colour
definition: Colour lookup shared by eye, hair and skin colour columns; 1 = No Colour, 7 = Blue.

name: Comic publisher
definition: Comic publisher such as Marvel Comics, DC Comics, Dark Horse Comics.

name: Hero gender
definition: Hero gender: Male, Female or N/A.

name: Hero race
definition: Hero species/race such as Human, Alien, Mutant.

name: Patient
definition: Patient with sex, birth date, in/out-patient flag and recorded diagnosis.

name: Patient sex
definition: Patient sex code M or F.

name: In/out-patient type
definition: Patient care type: '+' in-patient, '-' out-patient.

name: Disease diagnosis
definition: Recorded diagnosis text, possibly containing several comma-separated diseases.

name: Laboratory record
definition: Per-date laboratory record holding categorical immunology results (ANA pattern, coagulation, symptoms, thrombosis level).

name: Examination record
definition: Per-date examination record holding numeric blood and chemistry results.

name: ANA pattern
definition: Antinuclear antibody pattern text such as S, P or P,S.

name: Degree of coagulation
definition: Coagulation test result recorded as '+' (positive) or '-'; three separate measures exist.

name: Thrombosis level
definition: Integer thrombosis severity level (0-3).

name: Clinical symptom
definition: Free-text clinical symptom; a non-null value means symptoms are present.

name: Autoantibody result
definition: Qualitative autoantibody result for anti-scl70, anti-SSB, anti-centromere and ANA.

name: Anti-cardiolipin antibody
definition: Numeric anti-cardiolipin antibody measurement.

name: Blood glucose (GLU)
definition: Blood glucose laboratory value.

name: Total cholesterol (T-CHO)
definition: Total cholesterol laboratory value.

name: Creatinine (CREA)
definition: Serum creatinine laboratory value.

name: Creatinine phosphokinase (CPK)
definition: Creatinine phosphokinase enzyme laboratory value.

name: ALT / GPT
definition: Alanine aminotransferase (GPT/ALT) enzyme laboratory value.

name: Blood albumin (ALB)
definition: Serum albumin laboratory value.

name: Urea nitrogen (UN)
definition: Blood urea nitrogen laboratory value.

name: Platelet count (PLT)
definition: Platelet count laboratory value.

name: Immunoglobulin G (IgG)
definition: Serum IgG level.

name: Immunoglobulin M (IgM)
definition: Serum IgM level.

name: C-reactive protein (CRP)
definition: C-reactive protein result, recorded as a qualitative or semi-quantitative text value.

name: Molecule
definition: Molecule identified by a TR-prefixed id with a carcinogenicity label.

name: Carcinogenicity status
definition: Whether a molecule is carcinogenic ('+') or non-carcinogenic ('-').

name: Atom
definition: Atom belonging to a molecule and carrying one chemical element symbol.

name: Chemical element
definition: Lower-case chemical element symbol such as h, c, o, n, cl, s, br.

name: Chemical bond
definition: Bond within a molecule with a bond type.

name: Bond type
definition: Bond order symbol: '-' single, '=' double, '#' triple.

name: Bond-atom link
definition: Link between a bond and each of the two atoms it connects.
